name: Noszlop (Hungary)
description: Two equal vertical stripes of blue and red with a triangular notch cut from the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Noszlop: a blue, green and yellow shield with a crescent, a star, a sabre and a ploughshare.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
